method: Independent inspection of randomized blind sheet only; deterministic enlarged copies used for facial landmarks.

pairs.reason: A nose and chin project toward the left edge, with the face opening left beneath lifted bangs; B nose, visible eye and face profile project right.
A exposed face and nose are right of head center; B raised nose and chin point left, with near facial surface on the left.
A face profile and nose tip extend right; B nose and exposed cheek extend left while orange hair mass remains behind the head.
A head turns left with nose/eye on left side and flower behind on right; B nose/eye turn right with long hair trailing left.
A lowered face and nose are biased left; B lowered face, visible eye and nose are biased right.
A chin inclines down-left and the cheek opening is left of hair center; B nose and chin incline down-right, with face visible on right.
A bowed head retains a leftward nose and eye placement; B bowed head retains rightward nose/eye placement and a right-opening face.
A chin lowered toward chest with crown prominent and eyes directed below; B chin lifted, face points upward with eyes toward top and more lower face/neck exposed.
A head raised and nose/eye line tilted upward; B head bowed, face and eye line tilted downward toward the book/chest.
A chin drops and forehead/bangs cover more upper face; B face lifts, nose and gaze angle upward.
A nose slopes slightly down with lowered chin relative to neck; B nose and visible eye line angle upward, chin visibly higher.
A chin bends toward chest and eyes face below; B nose/chin lift strongly toward upper-left, exposing underside of face.
A face tilts back with nose aimed above and chin raised; B crown leads downward and chin tucks toward chest.
A eye and nose line incline upward with lifted chin; B face slopes below horizontal and chin is lowered.
